note: 高價值主題例句・短金句諺語：自寫+查證，待獨立 reviewer 複查出處。

items.sentence: Practice makes perfect.
Better late than never.
Actions speak louder than words.
Honesty is the best policy.
Look before you leap.
The early bird catches the worm.
Where there's a will, there's a way.
Don't judge a book by its cover.
When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
Every cloud has a silver lining.
Rome wasn't built in a day.
Two heads are better than one.
A picture is worth a thousand words.
All that glitters is not gold.
items.zh: 閃閃發光的未必都是金子。

items.sentence: Slow and steady wins the race.
Haste makes waste.
Necessity is the mother of invention.
No pain, no gain.
Don't count your chickens before they hatch.
items.zh: 蛋還沒孵就別數小雞（別打如意算盤）。

items.sentence: Great minds think alike.
Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.
items.zh: 美醜因人而異（情人眼裡出西施）。

items.sentence: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.
Patience is a virtue.
Better safe than sorry.
Hope for the best, prepare for the worst.
items.zh: 抱最好的希望，做最壞的打算。

items.sentence: Fortune favors the bold.
Laughter is the best medicine.
I have a dream.
The only thing we have to fear is fear itself.
items.zh: 我們唯一要恐懼的，就是恐懼本身。

items.sentence: To be, or not to be.
All the world's a stage.
items.zh: 整個世界就是一座舞台。

items.sentence: I think, therefore I am.
The unexamined life is not worth living.
items.zh: 未經省察的人生不值得活。

items.sentence: Imagination is more important than knowledge.
Knowledge is power.
Time is money.
items.attribution: Benjamin Franklin (Advice to a Young Tradesman, 1748)

items.sentence: Well done is better than well said.
Keep calm and carry on.
Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee.
items.zh: 像蝴蝶般飛舞，像蜜蜂般螫刺。

items.sentence: The pen is mightier than the sword.
